title: Editor Browser Live Backend Smoke
summary: Add a bounded browser-app smoke that launches the rendered Editor app against a live loopback Backend server and proves the browser-visible runtime can traverse the same Backend/Core compatibility path without relying only on Node-level harness evidence.
expectedOutput: An Editor-owned browser smoke test or a boundary blocker that distinguishes the rendered browser app plus live Backend/Core path from the accepted Node loopback harness, followed by Project Control evidence registration without broad map promotion.
riskSummary: The previous live harness is Node loopback evidence only; this lane must avoid treating a browser smoke as production readiness, must preserve Backend/Core ownership, and must not promote FlowDoc truth before browser evidence and owner gates pass.
